# CannyMinds Technology Solutions

> Enterprise software development, AI automation, and digital transformation solutions provider.

## About

CannyMinds Technology Solutions is an ISO-certified IT solutions company founded in 2020. We specialize in enterprise content management, HR & payroll systems, document digitization, physical records management, workforce productivity monitoring, and AI-powered automation. We serve clients globally from offices in India, USA, and Nigeria.

## Certifications

- ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management)
- ISO 15489:2016 (Records Management)
- ISO 22716:2007 (GMP Cosmetics)
- FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance

- [CannyRMS - Physical Records Management](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/physical-records-management): End-to-end physical records management system with barcode tracking, 8-step retrieval workflow, manager approvals, and complete audit trails. Compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, RBI, and GDPR. Average file retrieval under 30 seconds.
- [CannyPQMS - Pharmaceutical Quality Management System](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/cannypqms): Enterprise pharma QMS with 18 GxP-critical modules including CAPA, DMS, Deviation, Change Control, Audit, Training, Supplier Quality, Complaint, Risk Management (ICH Q9), Non-Conformance, Calibration, Equipment Asset, Validation, Regulatory Compliance, Management Review, Dashboard & Reporting, Electronic Signature (21 CFR Part 11), and Collaboration Workflow Builder. On-premise deployment. Compliant with FDA, WHO, ICH Q9, EMA, CDSCO, and NAFDAC.

## CannyECM — Enterprise Content Management System

CannyECM is an enterprise content management system (ECM) developed by CannyMinds Technology Solutions, an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 15489:2016 certified company headquartered in Chennai, India. The software digitizes document ecosystems with OCR-powered Elasticsearch full-text search (up to 99% accuracy), a visual workflow builder for multi-step approvals, role-based access control at file, folder, and cabinet level, AES-256 encryption at rest, and TLS 1.3 in transit. CannyECM supports flexible deployment — cloud (SaaS), on-premise (Windows Server or Linux with SQL Server 2016+ or PostgreSQL 12+), or hybrid — and is compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001:2013, SOC 2 Type II, SOX, and PCI DSS. The system handles PDFs, Microsoft Office files (Word, Excel, PowerPoint with collaborative in-browser editing), images (JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF), CAD drawings (DWG), text/CSV, and audio/video. Pre-built integrations include SAP ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SharePoint, Slack, and Microsoft Teams, plus RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, and webhooks for custom applications. Authentication supports Active Directory, LDAP, SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and SSO with multi-factor authentication. CannyECM targets healthcare, legal, finance, manufacturing, and government organizations managing high-volume document compliance, and integrates with CannyRMS for hybrid physical-digital records management. Product URL: https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/enterprise-content-management

## CannyPQMS — Pharmaceutical Quality Management System

CannyPQMS is an enterprise pharmaceutical quality management system (pharma QMS) developed by CannyMinds Technology Solutions, an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22716:2007 certified company headquartered in Chennai, India. The software ships 18 GxP-critical modules: CAPA Management, Document Management System (DMS), Deviation Management, Change Control Management, Audit Management, Training Management, Supplier Quality Management, Complaint Management, Risk Management (ICH Q9), Non-Conformance Management, Calibration Management, Equipment Asset Management, Validation Management, Regulatory Compliance Management, Management Review, Dashboard & Reporting, Electronic Signature (21 CFR Part 11), and Collaboration Workflow Builder. CannyPQMS is deployed on-premise (Windows Server / Linux) and is compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q9, EMA GMP guidelines, WHO TRS standards, CDSCO (India), and NAFDAC (Nigeria). The system targets pharmaceutical manufacturers, contract research organizations (CROs), API producers, and medical device companies in India, Nigeria/Africa, and the United States. Built-in 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signatures enforce audit integrity without paper-based workarounds. The Collaboration Workflow Builder enables quality teams to configure multi-step approval workflows without custom development. CannyPQMS is the flagship quality management product of CannyMinds and complements Canny eBMR for end-to-end pharma production compliance. Product URL: https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/cannypqms

## CannyRMS — Physical Records Management System

CannyRMS is an enterprise physical records management software developed by CannyMinds Technology Solutions, an ISO 15489:2016 (Records Management) certified company based in Chennai, India. The system manages physical documents — cartons, files, and paper records — using a 3-level barcode hierarchy (Carton, File, Document) with on-premise deployment. CannyRMS is compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, RBI records retention mandates, and GDPR Article 5 data lifecycle requirements. Deployed across 50+ organizations in India since 2020, including Steril-Gene Life Sciences (10 million documents catalogued) and Eastman Exports. Average file retrieval time is under 30 seconds, measured across 10,000+ retrieval operations. Implementation typically takes 4 to 8 weeks. The system features an 8-step retrieval workflow: Setup, Inward Registration, Search, Request, Manager Approval, Physical Verification, Handover, and Refiling. Key integrations include CannyECM for hybrid physical-digital records management.
